profile.scope_note: Two finished board profiles only. Manufacturer CAM must design/confirm panel supports, rails, tabs, tooling and separation; this artwork alone is not a mechanically connected assembly panel.

limitations: Uses the same Gerbonara parser library as the export workflow, but does not call the exporter, merge or offset helpers; comparisons use freshly parsed serialized output and manually translated expanded primitives.
Geometry/polarity equivalence is between native KiCad unit Gerbers and combined Gerbers. It is not a separate full copper-polygon comparison against KiCad PCB internals.
Drill coordinates and dimensions are independently compared directly against native PCB data; 0.0005001 mm per axis accommodates KiCad decimal Excellon rounding.
Both canonical PCBs omit a detailed physical stackup. This audit does not establish fabricator acceptance or detailed copper/dielectric construction.
No electrical or component-placement changes, source PCB edits, fabrication order or assembly order were made by this audit.
